visualCharacteristics.structure: grid of cards; each card = colored top image + heading + description + link list

contentPattern: Repeating card items. Each card: an image cell (colored header illustration) followed by a body cell with a title, a description paragraph, and an optional list of indication/product links.
usage: Used for the 'Our therapy areas' grid on content-landing pages: a 3-up responsive grid of therapy-area cards with colored image headers.
